commit_message:
[Merged] [wasm] Support inlining Proxy-on-Prototype traps

When a Wasm object's prototype chain is sufficiently immutable,
we can statically retrieve Proxy traps on it and embed them as
constants. The existing Wasm-into-JS inlining support can then
even inline the calls, making keyed load/store accesses from
optimized code via these Proxy traps much faster.

Bug: 403372470

fix_commit_message:
[ic] Fix KeyedHasIC feedback classification

The new "1 map, many names" feedback type is only used by keyed
load/store ICs, so when the optimizing compiler digests feedback
for keyed "has" ICs, it shouldn't mis-classify their feedback as
the new thing.

Fixed: 424245314
Change-Id: I40b16d321f37bd1473984e0e8024b21678f9bdea

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix a7220b894a98 on top of intro ef9dafb5ab5b via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: IsOneMapManyNames() checks only the shape of the feedback slot (a weak map reference + a Smi matching LoadGeneric/StoreGeneric) without first verifying that the FeedbackSlotKind is actually a keyed load or store IC. The '1 map, many names' mode is exclusively used by keyed load/store ICs; applying the same classification logic to KeyedHasIC feedback produces a false positive that subsequently violates the invariant asserted by ProcessFeedbackMapsForKeyedPropertyAccess.
